blocking_issues: BUG-01 [CRITICAL]: Service Worker ($app/manifest) passes {path} objects instead of URL strings to cache.addAll(), crashing PWA installation in production.
BUG-02 [CRITICAL]: Schema mismatch between Plant TypeScript interface (nested taxonomy, contributor_name, uploaded_by_name) and Supabase PostgreSQL flat columns in PlantRepository.
BUG-03 [HIGH]: Dynamic CMS categories from ConfigService are rejected by hardcoded Zod plantCategorySchema and missing from contribution form select & badge formatters.
BUG-04 [HIGH/SECURITY]: Admin pages (/admin/moderasi, /admin/pengaturan) auto-login guests as admin onMount and lack role guards against contributor access.
BUG-05 [MEDIUM]: Missing taxonomy_species input in contribution form, missing 5-minute video duration validation (BRD F2/F5), and unmoderated video status propagation.
BUG-06 [MEDIUM]: QrScanner fails when uploading QR image while camera is active, leaks camera stream on fast unmount, and allows unvalidated external redirects.
BUG-07 [ARCHITECTURE]: Route src/routes/peta/+page.svelte directly imports MapRepository instead of going through Service layer.
BUG-08 [MEMORY]: URL.createObjectURL previews in src/routes/kontribusi/tambah/+page.svelte are not revoked.
BUG-09 [CONFIG]: vite.config.ts uses @sveltejs/adapter-auto instead of installed @sveltejs/adapter-vercel.
BUG-10 [ANTI-BLOAT/DOCS]: Duplicate lucide-svelte dependency, unused 1.73MB static/logo-smk.png bloating PWA cache, dead vitest-examples, and stale Header Docs.
